title: An interval-moment criterion for square-difference-free integer sets
summary: We prove a general interval-moment criterion for square-difference-free integer sets and apply it to obtain an improved unconditional lower bound in Sarkozy's theorem, with exponent 0.7580758318008816. If D(N) is the largest size of a subset of {1, ..., N} containing no two distinct elements whose difference is a square, then for every epsilon > 0 and all sufficiently large N we prove D(N) >= N^(0.7580758318008816 - epsilon).
